data.content:
Predicted Udinese XI (3-4-2-1): Okoye; Abankwah, Palma, Solet; Vojvoda, Piotrowski, Karlström, Kamara; Chakvetadze, Ekkelenkamp; Davis.

Predicted bench: Padelli, Mrozek, Bertola, Ebosse, Kabasele, Zanoli, Zarraga, Miller, Lovric, Arizala, Jovanovic, Unai, Zaniolo, Vinciati.

Injuries & suspensions: Alaba, Bayo, Gueye, Zanoli.

## Head to head [...] Predicted bench: Torriani,  Bouyer, F. Terracciano, Vladimirov, Diawara, Estupinan, Perera, Comotto, Loftus-Cheek, Vos, Cisse, Menon, Ossola, Camarda.

Injuries & suspensions: Chukwueze, Gabbia, Gila, Moreira, Rabiot, Saelemaekers, P. Terracciano.

## The opponents [...] Two changes are expected in defence, with James Abankwah and Matteo Palma coming in, while Jakub Piotrowski looks set to replace Oier Zarraga in midfield. Other than that, it will be the expected Udinese with key players like  Jesper Karlström, Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and Kenan Davies.

Oumar Solet is in the predicted eleven right now, but Runjaic did warn that he might not make it due to a muscle problem.
